{"subject": "Reviewing cash in the Nakamura Household account", "body": "Dear Nakamura Household,

I am writing as your adviser to suggest a review of the cash position in your Individual brokerage (TOD) at Alder Clearing. Your cash is USD 203,190, or 10.3% of AUM, alongside your largest holding, Total market ETF (VTI), at 55.2% of AUM. With USD 104,190 identified as excess cash, a conversation about how that cash is held may be worthwhile.

You have been a client since 2020, and our last meeting was Jun 18, 2026. Your next review is due Jun 18, 2027. I would welcome the chance to talk through your preferences before then.

Please let me know if you would like to review this together.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield", "claims": [{"text": "Your cash is USD 203,190, or 10.3% of AUM", "source_field": "cash_usd"}, {"text": "Total market ETF (VTI), at 55.2% of AUM", "source_field": "top_holding_pct"}, {"text": "With USD 104,190 identified as excess cash", "source_field": "excess_cash_usd"}, {"text": "You have been a client since 2020", "source_field": "client_since_year"}, {"text": "our last meeting was Jun 18, 2026", "source_field": "last_meeting_date"}]}
